name: swiss-grid
title: Swiss Grid
description: High-contrast typographic brutalism governed by a visible grid, asymmetric composition, and one signal-red accent.

typography.fontFamily: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif

rules: Compose every page on a 12-column grid; intentional asymmetry is preferred to centered feature rows.
Use black rules and whitespace as the only elevation mechanisms; shadows and gradients are forbidden.
Set display type flush left with tight tracking and a maximum measure of twelve words per line.
Use red only for one dominant action or navigational marker per viewport.
Keep corners square, including badges, inputs, images, and overlays.
Use only regular and bold weights; create intermediate hierarchy through size and spacing.
Expose rules and dividers at 1px; use a 2px rule only for the primary axis of a layout.
Keep all spacing on the 8px grid and preserve empty grid cells as active composition.
Use tabular numerals and right-align numeric columns.
Limit transitions to 120ms state feedback; avoid parallax, floating cards, and ornamental animation.
